headline: ADNOC Partners with OpenAI to Forecast Oil Supply and Demand via AI
summary: State-owned oil company ADNOC announced a partnership with OpenAI to use artificial intelligence to predict crude oil supply, demand, and prices.
why: ADNOC is a major state-backed energy producer in the Middle East, and partnerships with leading AI developers highlight the growing integration of advanced predictive technology in traditional commodity markets.

impacts.name: ADNOC
impacts.why: Adopting AI for supply and demand forecasting may improve operational efficiency.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h
